reason: This plugin is primarily a Web UI utility panel for DeepSeek Harness users, focused on surfacing session telemetry and usage/cost information in a floating interface plus a local control for reasoning-effort and pricing display, based on documented session projection reads and official pricing synchronization.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端插件，在界面右下角以浮动面板展示会话的 Token 用量、上下文压力、推理等级切换与费用估算。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness web client plugin that shows a floating panel with session token usage, context pressure, reasoning-effort controls, and cost estimates.

capabilities: Reads session projection data from official RPC payloads for display and local cost estimation
Calls model-selection APIs to apply user-chosen reasoning effort settings
Fetches official pricing data via host-side network access and serves it through a same-origin route
Stores optional manual price overrides in browser localStorage

reasons.code: Plugin injects a floating compact panel in the Web UI to show session token usage/context pressure/reasoning level and cost estimates from session.list and session.models projections.
Plugin performs periodic host-side retrieval of official pricing page content and exposes it to client code via local plugin route.
Plugin is configured as a web client plugin (dsh.client) and installs via profile bundle/patch integration, indicating direct UI and web-side behavior.
